caption: Lightning flashes above a mountain hut in a snowstorm, and the falling snow is lit brightly for an instant.

sa.check: A mountain hut in falling snow.
The falling snow is lit brightly for an instant.
Snow is falling before and after the flash.
The scene is dim again after the flash.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: the snow and the hut brighten and return to dim; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The scene stays lit for the rest of the clip after the flash; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: During the flash the snowflakes show as bright specks or streaks across the frame and the snow on the ground and roof glints; between flashes they are dim.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the falling snow stays as dim as before; or the flakes are lit brightly while the sky and ground stay dark; or the flakes stay lit after the sky is dark; or the ground snow stays dull while the flakes and sky are lit.

pc.expect: The snow falls downward, drifting with the wind, before, during and after the flash.
pc.fail: The flakes rise or hang still; or change direction at the flash; or fall upward from the ground; or stop falling at the flash and resume afterwards.

pc.expect: The hut, the trees and the slope are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: The hut changes place or a second hut appears; or trees appear or vanish between frames; or the slope changes shape; or a lit window appears in the hut that was dark before.

pc.expect: The hut and trees keep their shapes; nothing passes through anything; any bolt seen ends in the air or at the ground, not inside the hut.
pc.fail: The hut changes shape; or a bolt passes through the hut and lights its interior; or a tree morphs into another object; or the snow on the ground turns into water.

pc.expect: The hut's wood, the snow and the sky keep their colours apart from the flash.
pc.fail: The hut changes colour; or the snow changes colour permanently; or the sky changes colour permanently after the flash.
